works.author: Deividas Bielskis
works.comment: 黑底着陆页，像素风笑脸由品红橙黄小方块拼成，One API key for every AI model, free ones included 一句话点题，下方 259 个模型、45+ 供应商、114 个免费、2.036T tokens 四个数字背书；开发者工具用“一张像素脸 + 四个大数字”把聚合 API 的卖点讲得又酷又可信。
works.comment_en: Unorouter's black landing page pairs a pixel-art smiley in magenta and orange with “One API key for every AI model, free ones included,” backed by four numbers — 259 models, 45+ providers, 114 free, 2.036T tokens served; one pixel face and four big numbers make an API aggregator feel both cool and credible.
works.title: Unorouter

works.author: Repo Studio
works.comment: 深色 AI 智能体总览仪表盘，Good morning, Thomas! 开场，Browser Time & Proxy Data 曲线配 Total Sessions 3、总浏览 5 分钟、平均 1 分钟三张小卡，下方任务状态 Completed 88、Running 12、Failed 5 一目了然；运维面板用“一句问候 + 一条曲线 + 三个数字”让智能体的执行状态一眼可读。
works.comment_en: Movix's dark AI-agent overview opens with “Good morning, Thomas!”, a Browser Time & Proxy Data curve over three small cards — 3 sessions, 5 minutes total browsing, 1 minute average — and task status (88 completed, 12 running, 5 failed) below; one greeting, one curve and three numbers make an agent fleet's execution readable at a glance.
works.title: Movix - AI Agent - Overview

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 粉紫渐变着陆页，手机上视频通话配 AI analysis 实时分析，右侧 5.0/5.0、#1 Rated、6,000+ Reviews 三重口碑背书；AI 会议工具用“一部手机 + 一个五星评分”把“开会不用记笔记”讲得明明白白。
works.comment_en: An AI meeting assistant landing page on a pink-purple gradient: a phone showing a video call with live AI analysis, backed by 5.0/5.0, #1 Rated and 6,000+ reviews; one phone and one five-star score explain “never take meeting notes again” with total clarity.
works.title: AI Meeting Assistant App

works.author: Jack R. for RonDesignLab
works.comment: 深色运动摄影打底，两张圆角卡片 Atlas redesign（12 recordings）与 Q4 roadmap（8 recordings）并排，毛玻璃录音堆叠配播放按钮；AI 录音 App 用“两张卡片 + 一张动态底图”把录音整理做得冷峻又高级。
works.comment_en: Plaud's AI recording app sets two rounded cards — Atlas redesign with 12 recordings and Q4 roadmap with 8 — over a dark, blurred sports photograph, frosted-glass recording stacks with play buttons; two cards and one moody backdrop make organizing recordings feel cool and premium.
works.title: Plaud — AI Recording Mobile App

works.author: SM Rubel
works.comment: ASOS 风格购物 App 三屏：首页 Spring Essentials 大横幅配 Dresses、Tops、Shoes、Beauty、Accessories 分类，列表页针织毛衣 $49、Oversized Blazer $89 标价清晰，详情页 Oversized Knitted Dress 4.8 分（120 条评价）、$700 原价 $950、XS–XL 尺码与 Add to Bag 一应俱全；电商 App 用“三屏走完逛到买”把购物流程做得顺滑完整。
works.comment_en: A fashion shopping app in three screens: a Spring Essentials hero with Dresses, Tops, Shoes, Beauty and Accessories categories, a listing with a $49 knit sweater and an $89 oversized blazer, and a product page — Oversized Knitted Dress, 4.8 from 120 reviews, $700 down from $950, sizes XS–XL and Add to Bag; three screens walk the whole journey from browsing to buying.
works.title: Fashion Shopping App UI – Modern E-commerce Mobile App Design

works.author: Gm Shamim
works.comment: 三屏加密钱包：My Cards 页 $250,00.00 余额配 Top up、Transfer、Send、Analytics 四个入口，中间 Swap 页 1.55 ETH 换 6809.87 SOL、粉色 Swap 按钮醒目，右侧 Send Money 页银行转账与最近联系人一字排开；金融 App 用“一个大余额 + 一颗粉色按钮”把换币转账讲得干净利落。
works.comment_en: A crypto wallet in three screens: My Cards with a $250,00.00 balance and Top up, Transfer, Send and Analytics; a Swap screen trading 1.55 ETH for 6809.87 SOL under a bold pink Swap button; and Send Money with bank transfer and recent contacts in a row; one big balance and one pink button make swapping and sending feel clean and effortless.
works.title: Crypto Wallet App UI – Digital Payments & Money Transfer

works.author: Sk Nayeem (AI Product Designer)
works.comment: 粉紫橙渐变健康仪表盘：Health Score 84/100 环形刻度镇场，心率 72 bpm 配全天点阵图，睡眠 7h30m、88% 质量，下方周活动柱状图、步数 8,421、卡路里 452、补水 1.8L、距离 6.9km 与最近三项运动排得满满当当；健康工具用“一个大分数 + 一屏小指标”把一周身体状态收进一页。
works.comment_en: VITALUX, a pink-purple-orange health dashboard: a Health Score of 84/100 in a ring gauge, heart rate 72 bpm over a dotted day-long chart, sleep 7h30m at 88% quality, and below, weekly activity bars, 8,421 steps, 452 kcal, 1.8L of water, 6.9 km and three recent workouts; one big score and a screen of small metrics fit a whole week of health into a single page.
works.title: VITALUX – Smart Health & Fitness Tracking Dashboard
